definitions.explanation: Describes a person who carefully calculates personal advantage in everything they do. Almost always negative, implying excessive self-interest or manipulation.

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}は{計算高|けいさんだか}い。
{計算高|けいさんだか}い{彼女|かのじょ}は{損|そん}になることは{絶対|ぜったい}にしない。
examples.english: Being calculating, she never does anything that doesn't benefit her.

examples.japanese: {親切|しんせつ}そうに{見|み}えるが、{実|じつ}は{計算高|けいさんだか}くて{自分|じぶん}の{利益|りえき}しか{考|かんが}えていない。
examples.english: He looks kind, but he's actually calculating and only thinks about his own interests.

notes:
USAGE:
{計算高|けいさんだか}い is almost always negative, suggesting someone who weighs every action in terms of personal gain. Unlike {賢|かしこ}い (clever) or {頭|あたま}がいい (smart), which are positive, {計算高|けいさんだか}い implies a cold, self-serving shrewdness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計算高|けいさんだか}い{人|ひと} (a calculating person)
- {計算高|けいさんだか}い{性格|せいかく} (a calculating personality)
- {計算高|けいさんだか}く{行動|こうどう}する (to act calculatingly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{狡|ずる}い (sly, unfair) is more bluntly negative. {抜|ぬ}け{目|め}がない (shrewd, missing nothing) can be slightly more neutral or even admiring.
